text:
The response is accurate. The figures, the 1 March review date, the 3-5% CPI collar for years 2-4, the landlord-appointed valuer, the year-4 floor, the 30-day dispute window with split costs, and the 14-day notice and late-notice rules all match the source. It also covers the points a manager would need.

However, it breaks the explicit limit of under 120 words. It runs to roughly 250-270 words, more than double the limit. Much of the excess is padding: an introductory sentence that restates the title, a closing "In short" paragraph that repeats the bullets, and a disclaimer. The detail on outgoings and late notice could also have been trimmed. A busy manager asked for a short summary and got one more than twice as long as requested.

Because the length constraint is clearly violated, despite good accuracy and coverage, the score is low.

Score: 3
